Container.Name: learnmylines
Container.Overview: Learn play lines with local British character voices, microphone recording and per-line scoring. Includes slow and fast rehearsal, group accounts, script assignments and optional email invitations. Configure an HTTPS reverse proxy before signing in or recording. First administrator setup uses the code in /data/admin-setup-code.
Container.License: Proprietary freeware; third-party components separately licensed
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: theatre drama rehearsal script lines voice acting
Container.Requires: x86-64 CPU. HTTPS proxy for login and microphone use. Internet for initial model downloads and optional email delivery. Writable appdata required. CPU inference; no GPU required. Optional experimental NVIDIA image available; see README for GPU setup.

Config.Name: Web port
Config.Description: Point your HTTPS proxy at the Unraid IP and this host port.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Essential accounts, scripts, progress and settings. Existing installs keep all current files until storage migration. Back up before updates.

Config.Name: Secure cookies
Config.Description: Keep 1 when using HTTPS. Plain HTTP sign-in will not work with secure cookies.

Config.Name: SSD working storage
Config.Description: Put this share on an SSD pool. Models, generated recordings and sound effects. Existing installs: migrate from Storage and backups after creating a backup.

Config.Name: Backup storage
Config.Description: Choose a separate share, ideally on the array. Full backups contain private accounts, scripts, recordings and email settings.
